plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Spanish (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Select any 100-499 course not used elsewhere, except SPAN 200-499.
[grid1 fn2] Select from the following: SPAN 301 , SPAN 302 or SPAN 304 , SPAN 303 , SPAN 306 , SPAN 307 , SPAN 318 , SPAN 350 , SPAN 352 , SPAN 407 , SPAN 417 , SPAN 452 , SPAN 462 .
[grid1 fn3] Select from the following: SPAN 311 , SPAN 312 , SPAN 320 , SPAN 331 , SPAN 332 , SPAN 341 , SPAN 342 , SPAN 410 , SPAN 411 , SPAN 412 , SPAN 413 , SPAN 414 , SPAN 421 , SPAN 423 , SPAN 445 , SPAN 450 , SPAN 460 , SPAN 461 .
[grid1 fn4] Select from SPAN 300-499, HISP 100-499; HISP-related courses (see HISP-Related Interdisciplinary Courses table), or any course, including 489 Special Topics, with 33% Hispanic focus.
